description: Write the full App Store listing for a new locale — name, subtitle, keyword field and description — from the app's source listing, with every keyword measured in that storefront first. The first call starts the write and answers pending (it takes one listing write from the plan: Free 1 in total, Pro 20 and Studio 75 a month); call again with poll=true until the listing comes back. With shots=true the screenshot captions come back in the same language too. Needs get_storefront_audit to have run for the app. Writes nothing to App Store Connect; update_listing does that.

improve.description: improve a locale that already has its own listing, fixing the problems the storefront audit found, instead of writing a missing one

locale.description: target locale, e.g. de_de, pt_br, ja_jp (de-DE also works)

poll.description: read the running write for this locale (uses nothing)

shots.description: also write the screenshot captions in this language: each source screenshot's caption lines read and rewritten with the listing's keywords (shots[].source and shots[].lines, with position and style)

name: localize_listing
